many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter
def f(di):
    h=len(di); w=len(di[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in di for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    R=sorted(set(r for r in range(h) if len(set(di[r]))==1 and di[r][0]!=bg))
    C=sorted(set(c for c in range(w) if len(set(di[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1 and di[0][c]!=bg))
    pr=[r for r in range(h) if r not in set(R)]; pc=[c for c in range(w) if c not in set(C)]
    comp=[[di[pr[i]][pc[j]] for j in range(len(pc))] for i in range(len(pr))]
    rs=[i for i in range(len(comp)) if any(comp[i][j]!=bg for j in range(len(comp[0]))) ]
    cs=[j for j in range(len(comp[0])) if any(comp[i][j]!=bg for i in range(len(comp)))]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    ph=r1-r0+1; pw=c1-c0+1
    blk=[[comp[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=[]
        for c in range(w):
            if r in set(R) or c in set(C):
                row.append(di[r][c]); continue
            ic=sum(1 for x in pc if x<c)
            jr=sum(1 for x in pr if x<r)
            row.append(blk[jr%ph][ic%pw])
        out.append(row)
    return out
for n in [3,4]:
    o=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); d=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print('demo',n)
    for r in range(len(d)):
        for c in range(len(d[0])):
            if o[r][c]!=d[r][c]:
                print('  ',r,c,'got',o[r][c],'want',d[r][c])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def f(di):
    h=len(di); w=len(di[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in di for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    R=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(di[r]))==1 and di[r][0]!=bg]
    C=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(di[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1 and di[0][c]!=bg]
    S_R=set(R); S_C=set(C)
    blkr=sorted(set(range(h))-S_R); blkc=sorted(set(range(w))-S_C)
    def fold(s, idxs):
        it=list(idxs); s=s
        while True:
            if len(it)==0: break
            a,b=it[0],it[-1]
            if s<a: s=2*a-s; it.pop(0)
            elif s>b: s=2*b-s; it.pop()
            else: break
        return s
    out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=[]
        for c in range(w):
            if r in S_R or c in S_C: row.append(di[r][c]); continue
            rr=fold(r,blkr); cc=fold(c,blkc)
            row.append(di[rr][cc])
        out.append(row)
    return out
for n in range(1,6):
    o=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); d=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
